beats.say: P equals P nought E to the power K T. It starts at one hundred and doubles every seven point five hours. Find K.
Starts at one hundred means T equals zero. So P nought is one hundred.
Doubling means two times one hundred. At T equals seven point five, P is two hundred, not two.
So two hundred equals one hundred E to the power seven point five K.
Divide both sides by one hundred, so the E part stands alone. E to the power seven point five K equals two.
E is involved, so take L N of both sides.
L N E is one, so the power comes down. Seven point five K equals L N two.
So K equals L N two over seven point five, about zero point zero nine two four.
